assessment_metadata.name: High-Specificity Adult ADHD Clinical Screener
authoritative_sources: Russell Barkley's Executive Functions Deficits Model
DIVA-5 Structured Diagnostic Interview (Examples of impairment)

instructions.rule_2: The Golden Rule: If you are hesitant, if the answer is 'sometimes', or if you are not 100% sure, you MUST answer 'No'.
instructions.rule_3: Answer 'Yes' only if the behavior happens significantly more often than your peers AND causes actual problems in your life.

thresholds.0-10: Unlikely ADHD. Symptoms likely reflect normal stress, anxiety, or lifestyle factors.
thresholds.11-20: Possible mild executive dysfunction. Monitoring recommended.
thresholds.21+: High probability of clinical ADHD. The strict 'No' rule implies these symptoms are persistent and impairing. Professional diagnosis strongly advised.

questions.text: Do you often delay starting an important task even when you intend to start, and this causes real problems (missed deadlines, stress, consequences)?
Do you mainly start work only when a deadline or consequence is very close, and this has caused problems for you?
In conversations, do you often lose track of what’s being said despite trying to pay attention, and this has caused misunderstandings or issues?
Do you avoid tasks that require sustained mental effort, and has this avoidance led to missed or late work?
In the past 6 months, have you misplaced important items more than once, and did it create real disruption or cost?
Is your living/work space often disorganized enough that it interferes with daily functioning or makes you avoid having people over?
Do you often make preventable mistakes in work (e.g., typos, wrong entries) even after checking, and has this caused problems?
Do you rely heavily on notes/alarms because you cannot depend on memory, and has this caused missed obligations when you don’t?
Do you frequently forget why you entered a room or started an action, and does it noticeably disrupt your day?
Does ordinary background noise often derail your focus more than it does for others, and does it interfere with your performance?
When you must sit still for 30+ minutes, do you feel unusually restless or uncomfortable compared with peers, and has it caused issues (leaving early, poor attention, conflict)?
Do you fidget frequently without intending to, and has it been noticeable or problematic (comments from others, inability to stay engaged)?
Do you often have racing thoughts at bedtime that make sleep difficult, and has this caused ongoing sleep problems?
Have people repeatedly told you that you interrupt or talk over them, and has it harmed relationships or work interactions?
Do you often speak before others finish because waiting feels very difficult, and has it created social or work problems?
Have you made a major life decision impulsively (job/relationship/commitment) and later faced significant negative consequences?
Do you buy things impulsively in a way that has caused financial stress, debt, or repeated regret?
Do you seek stimulation through risky or impulsive behaviors mainly to escape boredom, and has this caused harm or serious problems?
Do you often say things before fully thinking them through, and then regret it because it created problems?
Do you become much more frustrated than others in lines/traffic, and has it led to conflicts or impaired judgment?
Do you regularly underestimate how long tasks take and end up late or rushing, and has this caused problems?
Do you lose track of time during absorbing activities and neglect basic needs (meals, sleep, obligations), and has this caused issues?
Do you experience very intense emotional pain after perceived criticism or rejection that feels out of proportion, and does it disrupt your functioning?
Do your emotions shift noticeably within a day in response to events, and does it cause problems at work/school/home?
Do you frequently struggle to start your day even when you have slept enough, and does it cause repeated delays or missed responsibilities?
During multi-step tasks (cooking, errands), do you often lose track of steps and make errors, and has this caused real problems?
Do you often start new projects/hobbies with strong enthusiasm but stop within weeks, and has it created ongoing frustration or wasted resources?
When given three spoken instructions, do you often forget one, and has this caused mistakes or conflicts?
Do you get stuck polishing minor details while ignoring urgent priorities, and has it led to missed deadlines or poor outcomes?
Do transitions between tasks frequently leave you “stalled” for a while, and does it interfere with your day?
Do you often fail to respond or reach out for long periods and lose friendships or create tension because of it?
Do you frequently “hold it together” socially but feel significantly depleted afterward, and does it affect your daily life?
Do you often struggle to complete basic self-care routines because the steps feel overwhelming, and has this caused health/social issues?
Do you have recurring piles of unsorted items that you avoid dealing with, and does it interfere with living space or responsibilities?
In the last year, have avoidable fees/costs from lateness, lost items, or missed tasks happened repeatedly (3+), and was it a meaningful burden?
Do you often stay up much later than intended even when you must wake early, and has it caused ongoing sleep or performance problems?
Do you regularly need multiple alarms or external help to wake up on time, and has it caused problems (lateness, missed obligations)?
Do you often feel mentally overloaded (like too many things competing for attention), and does it impair your performance?
Do you often speed up videos/podcasts because normal pace loses your attention, and does it interfere with learning or tasks?
Looking back, did similar patterns show up in childhood/adolescence, and did they cause school or behavior problems?
Do you feel you must exert much more effort than peers to stay organized, and does it still result in problems or burnout?
Do you worry about being seen as incompetent because your workflow is chaotic, and has this fear or chaos caused real issues?
Are you unusually sensitive to certain sounds/textures compared with peers, and does it lead to strong irritation that affects your behavior or relationships?
Do you rely heavily on caffeine/sugar to function or start tasks, and has it caused health, sleep, or dependency problems?
Do you need another person present to complete boring/tedious tasks, and without it you often fail to finish?
Do these patterns persist even when you are not in an episode of depression/anxiety tied to a specific event?
Have these traits been consistent for many years rather than appearing only recently, and have they caused ongoing impairment?
Do you often feel you underperform mainly because execution breaks down, and has this meaningfully limited your outcomes?
Do you experience a persistent sense of underachievement even when you accomplish things, and does it affect your functioning or wellbeing?
If your external supports (alarms, lists, reminders, strict deadlines) were removed, would your day-to-day functioning deteriorate severely in a way that would quickly cause major problems?
